facts.text: DrawerTopOpen succeeds when the last normalized joint value of the base cabinet's drawer state is within TOLERANCE of 1
TOLERANCE is 0.1
The cupboard task base selects the counter_base_wall_3x1 preset and exposes its first BaseCabinet as cabinet_drawers
The first BaseCabinet of that preset enables big drawer 1 and small drawers 3 and 4
BaseCabinet.get_state returns the normalized position of every joint of the cabinet body
BiGymEnv is a Gymnasium environment whose default robot is H1
The control frequency is bounded to 20..500 Hz and the physics timestep is 0.002 s
The control_frequency constructor parameter defaults to CONTROL_FREQUENCY_MAX
The environment takes round(500/control_frequency) physics substeps per control call
The action space is built by the configured action mode with action_scale equal to the substep count
JointPositionActionMode builds a Box from the floating-base delta bounds, the limb control range and the gripper range
The H1 floating-base delta ranges are -0.01..0.01 for translation and -0.05..0.05 for rotation
The H1 limb delta action range is -0.1..0.1
The Robotiq 2F85 gripper control range is 0..1
The observation space is a Dict with proprioception and proprioception_grippers; a floating base adds floating-base position and accumulated-action arrays
The default ObservationConfig has no cameras, proprioception on and privileged information off
reset(seed, options) updates the seed, resets physics, action and robot, calls _on_reset and returns (observation, info)
step rejects an action with a wrong shape or outside the action space before stepping
step returns (observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info)
terminate is success or fail and truncate is not is_healthy
reward is success times SPARSE_REWARD_FACTOR
fail is true when the pelvis position norm exceeds MAX_DISTANCE_FROM_ORIGIN
MAX_DISTANCE_FROM_ORIGIN is 10
The cupboards reset robot position is [-0.2, 0, 0]
The README says tasks are instantiated directly

determinism.notes: reset(seed) accepts and records a seed and the fake's state transitions are deterministic, so the same seed and actions repeat the bridge state hashes; the fake does not draw its initial state from the seed, while upstream seeds numpy, so this is not a claim that a seed gives the same trajectory as the upstream MuJoCo model

gaps: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators or sensors: the fake integrates the floating base as a point, uses its x and y values for the 10 m failure distance, and moves the last drawer with the mean arm action, so forces, collisions and trajectories are not modelled and do not match MuJoCo

no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0; one fake control step is mapped to 2 ms because the default control frequency is 500 Hz and PHYSICS_DT is 0.002 s (bigym/bigym_env.py:25-28), not because the fake measures time

the observation arrays are shorter than upstream's: the fake returns 4 proprioception values instead of len(robot.qpos)+len(robot.qvel) (the H1 model and action mode determine the real length), 2 gripper values, and 3 floating-base position and accumulated-action values; the observation lengths are stand-ins

the action space is a 15-element stand-in for the default H1 JointPositionActionMode(floating_base=True, absolute=False) and Robotiq 2F85 configuration (3 floating-base, 10 arm/wrist and 2 gripper values); upstream builds it from the loaded model at construction time, so other action modes, robots, floating-DOF sets, control frequencies or gripper configurations change the shape and bounds, and this fake was not compared with the upstream environment
gymnasium, MuJoCo, dm_control and mojo are not imported by this package; no upstream environment was run and no recorded traffic is replayed

the fake has no simulation health monitor: truncation stays false unless a test sets its health flag; camera, depth and privileged observations and rendering are not modelled because the default ObservationConfig has no cameras

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
